decisions.reason: The lever handle family draws directly on the firm's core metalworking, finishing and ergonomic knowledge, so management can read early market signals and refine the line in-house rather than withdraw it after two years.

The mitred design relies on proprietary engineering and finishing know-how that the firm can absorb and improve, and two years is too short for a design family in this durable architectural segment to justify withdrawal.
The multifunctional lever extends the firm's barrier-free and ergonomic expertise, which matches its strategic direction, so feedback can be assimilated to improve the product rather than drop it.
This lever handle line sits within the established coordinated product families, where the firm's existing knowledge makes upkeep low-cost and low-risk.
The award-winning 1289 collection has a dedicated page and clear external validation, and it builds on core competencies, making it a flagship worth retaining and developing.
